module_title: Boilermaker Tools, Equipment, Machines and Materials
title: CNC Applications: Purpose, Limits and Controlled Information
objective: Understand the purpose of CNC applications and the importance of controlled digital information and authorised operation.
safety_boundary: Conceptual CNC awareness only; no programming or machine-operation instructions.

sections.heading: 1. CNC concept
sections.body: Computer Numerical Control uses programmed information to control machine movements and manufacturing tasks.

sections.heading: 2. Controlled data
sections.body: Digital files, dimensions and approved programs are controlled information and must correspond with the job requirement.

sections.heading: 3. Limits
sections.body: Automation does not remove the need for verification, quality control, safety and competent oversight.

sections.heading: 4. Authorisation
sections.body: Operating or programming CNC machinery requires appropriate training and workplace authorisation.

questions.question: What does CNC use to control machine tasks?
